pages.title: Selling goods
pages.text: The Shipping Box sells eligible goods through an explicit action in its interface. There is no need to wait for dawn. Sale proceeds and withdrawing physical Coins are separate actions. Damaged items, arbitrary item data and packaged storage contents can make goods ineligible.

pages.title: Market access
pages.text: The market and wallet belong to Economy. If the host disables it, monetary actions are unavailable while balances and Coins remain saved. Settlements use their native emerald contract without Economy. The handbook never enables the economy or makes a payment.
